$description: Accepted market overrides for the iOS header band and Android status bar (DEC-15). Karl accepted every suggested override on 2026-11-05: these markets keep the color their app ships instead of following navbar. Read by scripts/build_tokens.py (override tokens) and scripts/build_shell_colors.py (docs). The value always comes from the shipped data, never from this file.

notes.statusbar: Android status-bar icon color is unknown (MISSING-ASSETS 5.6, asked 2026-11-05). If the apps turn on dark icons (windowLightStatusBar) in these markets, the overrides can be dropped and the markets follow navbar.
